title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Description: AI Automation Engineer**

**Location:** Vidyavihar, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 6 Months – 1 Year  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Eligibility:** passed-out candidates with relevant hands-on experience  
**Work Location:** Mumbai-based candidates only, preferably residing near Vidyavihar.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated **AI Automation Engineer** with hands-on experience in n8n, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Prompt Engineering. The ideal candidate should be passionate about building intelligent automation workflows, integrating AI models with business applications, and developing AI-powered solutions to automate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered automation workflows using **n8n**.
* Build and implement **RAG-based applications** using LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and document retrieval techniques.
* Develop, test, and optimize prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Integrate AI models and third-party APIs into automated workflows.
* Work with tools such as OpenAI APIs, webhooks, REST APIs, and databases.
* Automate business processes, data handling, and information retrieval using AI.
* Debug workflows, troubleshoot integration issues, and improve automation reliability.
* Collaborate with the team to develop and deploy practical AI automation solutions.

**Required Skills**

* **n8n:** Hands-on experience creating workflows, configuring nodes, and integrating APIs.
* **RAG:** Understanding of document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval pipelines.
* **Prompt Engineering:** Ability to design effective prompts and evaluate LLM responses.
* **LLMs:** Familiarity with models such as GPT, Gemini, Claude, or open-source alternatives.
* **API Integration:** Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication.
* **Programming:** Basic Python knowledge is preferred.
* **Databases:** Familiarity with SQL or vector databases such as ChromaDB, Pinecone, or FAISS is an advantage.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Candidates must have **completed their graduation or post-graduation**; currently pursuing candidates are not eligible.
* Candidates should have **6 months to 1 year of relevant hands-on experience** in n8n, RAG, Prompt Engineering, or AI automation projects.
* Candidates must be based in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
* Candidates residing near **Vidyavihar, Mumbai**, are strongly preferred.
* Candidates should be available to work from the designated Mumbai office.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building end-to-end AI automation workflows.
* Experience developing chatbots, AI agents, or document-based question-answering systems.
* Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks.
* A portfolio of practical AI automation or RAG projects.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a proactive, quick learner who can build practical AI solutions, take ownership of assigned tasks, and contribute to developing reliable AI-driven automation systems.

How to Apply

Interested and eligible candidates can share their updated resume along with details of their relevant n8n, RAG, and Prompt Engineering projects.

**Important:** Only passed-out candidates based in Mumbai and willing to work near Vidyavihar will be considered.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* 1. Have you completed your graduation or post-graduation?
* 2. Are you currently residing in Mumbai and willing to commute daily to our office in Vidyavihar?
* 3. How much hands-on experience do you have in AI automation, n8n, RAG, or Prompt Engineering?
* 4. Do you have hands-on experience building automation workflows using n8n?
* 5. Have you built or implemented a RAG-based application using an LLM, embeddings, and a vector database?

title: CRM & Automation Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on **CRM & Automation Engineer** who can build, integrate, and automate our CRM and business systems.

This is a technical role for someone who understands **CRM platforms, APIs, webhooks, automation tools, and coding**. The ideal candidate should be comfortable building systems rather than simply using CRM software.

Key Responsibilities

* Build, configure, and manage CRM systems such as **HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or similar platforms**.
* Design and implement automated workflows across the customer lifecycle, including lead nurturing, follow-ups, retention, and win-back journeys.
* Build and manage **API and webhook integrations** between CRM, communication platforms, internal systems, and other SaaS applications.
* Create automation workflows using **Zapier, Make, n8n, or equivalent platforms**.
* Develop custom solutions and integrations using **Python, JavaScript, and/or SQL**.
* Maintain real-time data synchronization between multiple systems.
* Build lifecycle stages, customer segmentation, triggers, and automated actions.
* Develop dashboards and reports covering **revenue, retention, churn, customer engagement, and marketing attribution**.
* Identify manual processes and convert them into automated workflows.
* Troubleshoot integration, automation, and data-sync issues.
* Work closely with Sales, Operations, and Customer Service teams to understand business requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
* Continuously improve existing workflows, automations, integrations, and reporting systems.

Must-Have Skills

* 1–5 years of relevant experience.
* Hands-on experience **building/configuring CRM systems**, not just using them.
* Strong experience with **APIs and webhooks**.
* Hands-on experience with **Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar automation tools**.
* Basic-to-intermediate coding experience in **Python, JavaScript, or SQL**.
* Experience building dashboards and reports linked to business metrics.
* Strong understanding of data flow and system integrations.
* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience as a:

* Full Stack Developer
* Automation Engineer
* Integration Engineer
* CRM Developer
* Software Engineer
* Systems Engineer
* Technical CRM Specialist

will be preferred, provided they have hands-on CRM and automation experience.

Important

**This is NOT a traditional CRM operations/admin role.**

We are specifically looking for someone who can **code, build automations, work with APIs/webhooks, and integrate multiple systems.**

Key Technologies

**CRM:** HubSpot / Salesforce / Zoho / Similar  
**Automation:** Zapier / Make / n8n / Similar  
**Coding:** JavaScript / Python / SQL  
**Integration:** REST APIs / Webhooks / System Integrations  
**Analytics:** Dashboards / Reporting / Business Metrics

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable working from Grant Road, Mumbai, or relocating to Mumbai ?
* What is your current CTC ?
* What is your expected CTC ?
* What is your notice period ?
